harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established an AIDE-based file integrity baseline for /etc on node1. Installed AIDE, strengthened the default config's catch-all rule from PERMS-only (metadata only) to NORMAL (adds content hashing) so uncategorized /etc files have content changes tracked, then initialized and activated the baseline database at /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz. Verified detection end-to-end by editing /etc/motd and confirming AIDE flagged the content change, then reverted the test edit and reinitialized the baseline to a clean, current state. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and baseline hash, issued a systemd reboot, confirmed the node briefly became unreachable then returned with a new boot_id, and verified the AIDE database persisted (identical sha256) with a post-restart aide --check reporting no differences.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 9.8) and confirmed AIDE was not installed
Installed aide package via dnf
Reviewed /etc/aide.conf default ruleset covering /etc

Backed up original config to /etc/aide.conf.orig.bak and changed the final catch-all rule from '/etc PERMS' to '/etc NORMAL' to add content-hash coverage for files not explicitly listed elsewhere in the config
Ran aide --init and installed the resulting database as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz (the active baseline)
Ran aide --check to confirm a clean baseline (no differences, 39333 entries)
Appended a line to /etc/motd and re-ran aide --check to prove the baseline detects content changes (reported hash mismatch on /etc/motd)
Reverted /etc/motd to its original content and re-ran aide --init / installed a fresh clean baseline (39334 entries after including motd)
Repeated the edit/detect/revert cycle once more and reinitialized to leave the filesystem and baseline in their final clean, matching state
Captured pre-restart boot_id and aide.db.gz sha256 as healthy-baseline evidence
Issued 'systemctl reboot' on node1 in the background so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned and confirmed boot_id changed from bef0e5ec... to 33a0bbf0..., proving an actual reboot occurred
Verified post-restart that /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz sha256 was unchanged (data persisted across reboot) and that aide --check reported no differences

evidence.requirement: AIDE installed and baseline database initialized for /etc integrity tracking
evidence.summary: Confirmed AIDE absent on RHEL 9.8 node1, installed aide-0.19.2, reviewed default /etc coverage, and ran aide --init producing a 39333-entry database.

evidence.requirement: Config strengthened so content changes to /etc files are detected (not just permissions)
evidence.summary: Changed the default catch-all '/etc PERMS' (metadata-only) rule to '/etc NORMAL' (adds sha512 content hashing) in /etc/aide.conf, backing up the original config first.

Installed the reinitialized database (post config change) to /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz and ran aide --check confirming 'AIDE found NO differences between database and filesystem. Looks okay!!' with 39334 entries.

evidence.requirement: Baseline proven to detect later changes to /etc files
evidence.summary: Appended a line to /etc/motd and re-ran aide --check, which reported 'AIDE found differences between database and filesystem!!' with 'f > ... H.... : /etc/motd' showing the content-hash mismatch was detected.
Reverted /etc/motd, reran aide --init, installed the refreshed database, and confirmed a clean aide --check ('Looks okay!!', 39334 entries, sha256 4dcca975...).
Captured boot_id bef0e5ec-ce32-423b-826a-8a5a90584d3a and confirmed aide.db.gz sha256 4dcca975... plus aide service state prior to restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued systemctl reboot (acknowledgement returned), observed connection timeouts while the node was down, then reconnected and read a new boot_id 33a0bbf0-1f23-489f-975c-b29a564a4128, proving an actual restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of integrity baseline (data and function)
evidence.summary: Confirmed /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz sha256 unchanged (4dcca975...) after reboot, and aide --check ran successfully reporting 'AIDE found NO differences between database and filesystem. Looks okay!!' with 39334 entries.
